definition_i18n.zh-TW: 霧是主角——霧漫進森林、樹影半掩的題材。唯一反轉能見度邏輯的題材（owner 核可 2026-11-16）：決勝條件是「霧正在發生（能見度 50–500 m）或霧形成中（RH≥95% 且溫露差 <1°C）」二擇一（ANY 語義）；能見度 >1 km 明確判「無霧」。光線限晨昏斜射的柔和散射光（太陽高度角 ≤10°，夜間不成立——看不見樹），晨窗（日出後 1–3 h）為優先窗；無雨、微風（風吹散霧）；季節限高濕季節窗（台灣 12–4 月最穩，讀 seasonal-calendar）。
definition_i18n.en: The fog IS the subject - mist drifting through the forest, half-veiling the trees. The only genre that INVERTS the visibility logic (owner-approved 2026-11-16): the decisive condition is fog happening (visibility 50-500 m) OR fog forming (RH >= 95% AND dew-point spread < 1 deg C) - owner ANY semantics; visibility > 1 km is an explicit no-fog failure. Light is limited to soft low-angle scatter (sun elevation <= 10 deg; night never qualifies - the trees cannot be seen), with the morning window (1-3 h after sunrise) as the PRIORITY window; no rain, calm wind (wind disperses fog); high-humidity season window only (Taiwan: Dec-Apr most reliable, read from the seasonal calendar).
definition_i18n.ja: 霧が主役——森に流れ込む霧、木々を半ば隠す被写体。視程ロジックを反転する唯一のジャンル（オーナー承認 2026-11-16）：決定条件は「霧が発生中（視程50-500m）」または「霧が形成中（RH95%以上かつ温度露点差1℃未満）」の二択（ANY 意味論）；視程1km超は明確な「無霧」失敗。光は朝夕の斜光による柔らかい散乱光（太陽高度10°以下、夜間は不成立——木が見えない）、朝の窓（日の出後1-3時間）を優先窓とする；無雨、微風（風は霧を散らす）；高湿季節窓のみ（台湾は12-4月が最も安定、季節カレンダー参照）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 決勝條件（反轉，owner 核可 2026-11-16）：霧是主角，能見度必須低。二擇一（ANY 語義）：能見度 50–500 m（霧正在發生），或 RH≥95% 且溫露差 <1°C（霧形成中，能見度尚未落進霧帶但飽和邊緣已具備）。能見度 >1 km → 明確「無霧」失敗。能見度缺欄時誠實 UNKNOWN，絕不虛構判定。
rationale_i18n.en: Decisive condition (INVERTED, owner-approved 2026-11-16): the fog is the subject, so visibility must be LOW. EITHER branch satisfies (owner ANY semantics): visibility 50-500 m (fog happening), or RH >= 95% with dew-point spread < 1 deg C (fog forming - visibility not yet inside the fog band but the saturation edge is present). Visibility > 1 km is an explicit no-fog failure. A missing visibility cell degrades honestly to UNKNOWN, never a fabricated verdict.
rationale_i18n.ja: 決定条件（反転、オーナー承認 2026-11-16）：霧が主役なので視程は低くなければならない。いずれか一方で成立（ANY 意味論）：視程50-500m（霧が発生中）、または RH95%以上かつ温度露点差1℃未満（霧が形成中——視程はまだ霧帯に入っていないが飽和縁は十分）。視程1km超は明確な「無霧」失敗。視程欠損時は誠実にUNKNOWN。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 柔和散射光（必要條件）：小時桶每一瞬間都必須在民用光線內（>−6°）——夜間一律不成立（看不見樹）；且桶內存在太陽高度角 ≤10° 的晨昏斜射取樣（斜光存在才成立；冬季 (−6°,10°] 帶寬不足一小時，採「整桶民用光＋桶內有斜光」語義，卡片以該精確時刻標記）。高角度陽光直穿林冠變硬光，不成立。threshold_source=computed，純太陽幾何。
rationale_i18n.en: Soft scattered light (necessary condition): EVERY instant of the hour bucket must be inside civil light (> -6 deg) - night hours never qualify (the trees cannot be seen); AND the bucket must contain at least one sampled instant with sun elevation <= 10 deg (slant light present; the midwinter (-6,10] band is shorter than one hour, so the semantics read whole-bucket civil light + slant sample present, and the card stamps that precise instant). High-angle sun punching through the canopy is harsh light and does not qualify. threshold_source=computed, pure solar geometry.
rationale_i18n.ja: 柔らかい散乱光（必要条件）：バケット内の全時点が市民光内（>-6°）であること——夜間は一律不成立（木が見えない）；かつ桶内に太陽高度10°以下の斜光サンプルが存在すること（冬季の帯幅は1時間未満のため「全桶市民光＋斜光サンプルあり」の意味論。カードはその精確時刻を刻む）。高角度の陽光は林冠を硬く貫き不成立。threshold_source=computed、純粋な太陽幾何。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 晨窗（優先窗，加分項）：日出後 1–3 小時是森林輻射霧最濃、光線斜射最佳的重疊段；此窗成立時拍攝優先度最高，但屬 MODIFIER——不單獨否決（夜間已由 L1 排除）。極區無日出事件時誠實 UNKNOWN。
rationale_i18n.en: Morning window (PRIORITY, advisory): the 1-3 h after sunrise is where radiation fog is thickest and slant light best - the highest-priority shooting overlap; MODIFIER tier, never a lone veto (night is already excluded by L1). Polar no-sunrise spans degrade honestly to UNKNOWN.
rationale_i18n.ja: 朝の窓（優先窓、加点項）：日の出後1-3時間は放射霧が最も濃く斜光が最良の重なり；成立時は最優先だが MODIFIER——単独では否決しない（夜間はL1が排除）。極域で日の出がない場合は誠実にUNKNOWN。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 無雨 <0.2 mm/h：雨會把霧沖成水幕、打濕鏡頭與步道，也代表系統性降水在吃掉霧的層結（沿用已審門檻 0.2）。
rationale_i18n.en: No rain < 0.2 mm/h: rain washes the fog into a water curtain, soaks lens and trail, and marks synoptic precipitation eating the fog layer (carried-over reviewed threshold 0.2).
rationale_i18n.ja: 無雨 <0.2mm/h：雨は霧を水幕に変え、レンズや遊歩道を濡らし、霧の層構造を崩す系統性降水の兆し（既審閾値0.2を踏襲）。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 風 ≤3 m/s：風是霧的侵蝕媒介——風吹散霧，林間霧幕隨風速上升快速消散；3 m/s 為 provisional，霧林帶地形風場較穩時可依點差異化。
rationale_i18n.en: Wind <= 3 m/s: wind erodes fog - gusts disperse the forest fog veil, which decays fast as wind rises; 3 m/s is provisional and may be differentiated per spot where the fog-forest terrain wind field is steadier.
rationale_i18n.ja: 風3m/s以下：風は霧を侵食する——風が霧の幕を散らし、風速上昇とともに林内の霧は急速に消える。3m/sは暫定値で、霧林帯の地形風が穏定な地点では差別化可。

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 季節窗（必要條件）：高濕季節才穩定出現輻射／平流霧——台灣 12–4 月最穩（東北季風高濕＋晨間輻射冷卻）；照 seasonal-calendar 例年窗對拍（實況窗優先，兩者皆缺時誠實 not_evaluatable）。
rationale_i18n.en: Seasonal window (necessary condition): radiation/advection fog is only reliable in the high-humidity season - Taiwan Dec-Apr most stable (monsoon moisture + morning radiative cooling); judged against the seasonal-calendar typical window (current-season live window takes precedence; with neither present the genre is honestly not_evaluatable).
rationale_i18n.ja: 季節窓（必要条件）：放射霧・移流霧は高湿季節にのみ安定——台湾は12-4月が最も安定（モンスーン湿気＋朝の放射冷却）；季節カレンダーの例年窓と突き合わせ（実況窓優先、両方欠ければ誠実にnot_evaluatable）。

owner_review: 2026-11-16 owner-approved (CL-DATA-73 ticket directive, 必做): the ONLY genre allowed to invert the visibility logic - fog is the photographic subject itself. F1 fog_state carries the owner ANY semantics (fog happening OR fog forming; >1 km = explicit no-fog failure) via the evaluator-derived cell; L1 soft-light (sun <= 10 deg, night never qualifies) is REQUIRED; M1 morning window (sunrise +1-3 h) is the PRIORITY advisory (MODIFIER); F2 no-rain < 0.2 and F3 wind <= 3 m/s follow the owner-specified thresholds; S1 seasonal gate rides the CL-DATA-72 seasonal-calendar engine (Taiwan typical window 12-01..04-30, owner ticket directive).
revision_note: 0.1 initial template (CL-DATA-73): fog decisive inversion (owner-approved), soft-light + morning windows, no-rain, calm wind, seasonal gate via seasonal-calendar.
